# signoz_saved_view (Data Source)

Reads a single saved view by `id`, or by `name` with optional `source_page` and `category` query filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "signoz_saved_view" "error_logs" {
  name        = "terraform-error-logs"
  source_page = "logs"
}

output "saved_view_id" {
  value = data.signoz_saved_view.error_logs.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Optional category label in the UI. Default: omitted (empty string). Optional filter when looking up by `name`. Default: omitted.
- `id` (String) Object UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set for lookup. When using `name` lookup, set optional `source_page` and `category` to match list API filters.
- `name` (String) Object name (unique within the organization for that resource type). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set for lookup.
- `source_page` (String) Explorer page this view belongs to. Valid values: `logs`, `traces`, `metrics` (SigNoz explorer tabs). Optional filter when looking up by `name`. Default: omitted.

### Read-Only

- `composite_query` (String) JSON explorer query (`CompositeQuery` in query-service). Required. Must include `queryType` (typically `builder`) and `queries` with valid builder specs for the `source_page` signal.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `created_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that created the object. Read-only.
- `extra_data` (String) Optional opaque JSON string used by the SigNoz UI for extra state. Default: omitted (empty string).
- `tags` (List of String) Optional list of tag strings. Default: omitted (no tags).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
- `updated_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that last updated the object. Read-only.
